metadataRaw.title: One Move for a Stronger Back and Butt
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a modified bird-dog exercise using the edge of bed.

This easy exercise can be done daily to help strengthen the core, back, and glutes (buttocks) to help lessen AND prevent injuries and pain.

Let us know how it works for you!

Dr. Michael Rowe
